items.t: Mattress commission question: I’m going to need a new mattress for one year, and one year only. (Husband has to move out of state and will be taking current bed, but I am legally tied to my state for custody reasons until my son turns 18 next year, then I will be moving in with Husband again and won’t need the Temporary Bed… I’ll be using an heirloom queen-size frame that I’ve kept in storage, so Temporary Bed won’t fit on the king-size frame that will be going to the new place.) So, luckily there are a lot of online places with 365-day free returns and that seems like a much better option than buying a cheap “disposable” bed. I know, I know… you hate beds-in-a-box but since I’m not looking for long-term durability I’m choosing to ignore that part of your advice. There’s a local mattress store near me that has the one I think I want. I’m inclined to buy one in-person so that someone gets a commission. So my questions are: 1) Will the manufacturer’s return policy still apply if I don’t buy it directly from their online store? 2) Will the salesperson get to keep their commission when I return it to the manufacturer in a year? 3) Is there something I haven’t thought of that will make me regret this plan?
